items.descriptionAdvanced: The San Diego Zoo, located in Balboa Park, is one of the world's most renowned zoological gardens, known for its pioneering approach to wildlife conservation, open-air habitat design, and extensive biodiversity. Founded in 1916, it has played a leading role in the transition from traditional menagerie-style exhibits to immersive, naturalistic environments that emphasize animal welfare and public education. The zoo is a global hub for research, actively participating in breeding programs for endangered species like the giant panda and the California condor. With its lush, curated landscapes and year-round favorable climate, it attracts millions of visitors annually, standing as a premier destination for studying global biology and conservation science. Sachkunde K5 — Wildlife habitats and conservation biology.

items.descriptionAdvanced: Yellowstone National Park, established in 1872 as the first national park in the world, is an ecological wonderland defined by its extraordinary geothermal activity and diverse wildlife populations. Sitting atop a massive supervolcano, the park hosts half of the world’s active geysers, including the world-famous Old Faithful. Its vast, pristine landscape is home to thriving populations of iconic North American fauna, such as bison, grizzly bears, wolves, and elk, making it a critical site for understanding trophic cascades and habitat management. The park represents the foundational birth of the modern global conservation movement, preserving a unique high-altitude wilderness that serves as a vital laboratory for biological research and ecological stability. Biologie K7 — Geothermal ecology and megafauna habitat management.
factsAdvanced: First national park in the world, established in 1872.

Vital laboratory for high-altitude biology and conservation science.

items.descriptionAdvanced: Walt Disney World Resort in Orlando, Florida, is the largest and most-visited theme park resort in the world, acting as a profound cultural and economic engine for the American entertainment industry. Since its opening in 1971, it has fundamentally reshaped the model for modern tourism, creating an immersive, multi-park vacation experience that seamlessly integrates technology, storytelling, and high-capacity infrastructure. The resort is a massive city-like enterprise, employing tens of thousands and setting global standards for service excellence, crowd management, and themed hospitality. Its influence extends far beyond entertainment, serving as a masterclass in operational logistics and the commercial power of intellectual property and brand-driven consumer culture. Wirtschaft K8 — Tourism infrastructure and immersive entertainment models.
